d: Ash-grey hair is styled in a messy ponytail with long, jagged bangs framing a youthful, mature face and sharp, narrow crimson eyes. The slender build is dressed in a fragmented navy-blue outfit consisting of a detached sleeve on one arm, a matching tattered overcoat worn open, a dark bikini top under white fabric wrappings, and a heavy utility belt with multiple pouches over a short, asymmetrical navy skirt. Accessories include a black choker, dark lace-up boots, and a tactical rifle held in one hand, with a rectangular grey electronic device sitting on the ground.
